# Architectural spec for `scen-check-fix-records-mapping`.
#
# The word mapping says how "mcp service" and "message" are built and
# observed, and says nothing of "reply", which E2E-001 relies on; the fix
# adds the mapping.

architecture:
  testing:
    framework: go-test
    commands:
      record: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/... -mode=record
      replay: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/... -mode=replay
      live: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/...
  services:
    - name: mcp-service
      path: services/mcp-service
      language: go
  terms:
    - term: mcp service
      technical: >-
        The mcp-service binary, serving JSON-RPC over HTTP on the port its
        config names.
      observed_by: >-
        Start the binary in the run directory and wait until its port
        accepts a connection.
    - term: message
      technical: >-
        One JSON-RPC request whose params carry the text, posted to /mcp.
      observed_by: >-
        Post the request to /mcp and keep the response for the steps after.
    - term: reply
      technical: >-
        The JSON-RPC response the mcp-service returns for the request
        posted to /mcp, whose result field carries the answer text.
      observed_by: >-
        Read the response the When step kept, decode its JSON-RPC result
        and compare that text to the one the step states.
